# Wayfair
> Wayfair is an online home retailer offering furniture, decor, lighting, kitchenware, outdoor products, and home improvement items across many styles and budgets.

Wayfair serves consumers shopping for home products across major living spaces and categories, while also operating dedicated programs and resources for suppliers, professionals, and business buyers. Its web presence spans retail shopping, category hubs, customer service, registry tools, credit and financing information, and partner-facing seller resources.

## Shopping Categories
- [Furniture](https://www.wayfair.com/furniture/sb0/furniture-c45974.html): Browse sofas, beds, tables, storage, seating, and furniture for every room.
- [Home Decor](https://www.wayfair.com/decor-pillows/sb0/home-decor-c1860891.html): Shop wall art, mirrors, rugs, accents, pillows, and decorative accessories.
- [Lighting](https://www.wayfair.com/lighting/sb0/lighting-c215390.html): Explore ceiling lights, lamps, sconces, chandeliers, and outdoor lighting fixtures.
- [Rugs](https://www.wayfair.com/rugs/cat/rugs-c215386.html): Find area rugs, runners, doormats, and rug options by size and style.
- [Kitchen & Tabletop](https://www.wayfair.com/kitchen-tabletop/sb0/kitchen-tabletop-c45653.html): Shop cookware, dinnerware, small appliances, bakeware, and kitchen essentials.
- [Bed & Bath](https://www.wayfair.com/bed-bath/sb0/bed-bath-c1860888.html): Browse bedding, bath accessories, towels, vanities, and bathroom storage products.
- [Storage & Organization](https://www.wayfair.com/storage-organization/sb0/storage-organization-c45983.html): Discover closet systems, shelving, bins, cabinets, and organization solutions.
- [Outdoor](https://www.wayfair.com/outdoor/sb0/outdoor-c1860973.html): Shop patio furniture, grills, garden decor, umbrellas, and outdoor entertaining items.

## Home Improvement
- [Home Improvement](https://www.wayfair.com/home-improvement/sb0/home-improvement-c1861008.html): Explore fixtures, hardware, flooring, tools, and renovation-related home products.
- [Bathroom Fixtures](https://www.wayfair.com/home-improvement/sb0/bathroom-fixtures-c1861009.html): Shop sinks, faucets, shower systems, toilets, and bathroom installation essentials.
- [Kitchen Fixtures](https://www.wayfair.com/home-improvement/sb0/kitchen-fixtures-c1861010.html): Browse kitchen sinks, faucets, filtration, and fixture accessories.
- [Flooring & Tile](https://www.wayfair.com/home-improvement/sb0/flooring-tile-c1861012.html): Find tile, vinyl, hardwood, and flooring materials for renovation projects.
- [Hardware](https://www.wayfair.com/home-improvement/sb0/hardware-c1861013.html): Shop cabinet pulls, knobs, hinges, locks, and general home hardware.
- [Tools & Workshop](https://www.wayfair.com/home-improvement/sb0/tools-workshop-c1861017.html): Browse hand tools, power tools, ladders, and workshop equipment.

## Rooms & Inspiration
- [Living Room](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/guides/living-room): Inspiration and shopping ideas for seating, tables, storage, and decor.
- [Bedroom](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/guides/bedroom): Guides and product ideas for beds, dressers, nightstands, and bedding.
- [Dining Room](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/guides/dining-room): Planning ideas and furniture recommendations for dining spaces.
- [Home Office](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/guides/home-office): Tips and product selections for desks, chairs, and office organization.
- [Small Space Living](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/guides/small-space-living): Space-saving ideas and products for apartments and compact homes.
- [Outdoor Spaces](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/guides/outdoor): Inspiration for patios, decks, gardens, and outdoor entertaining areas.

## Ideas & Advice
- [Ideas & Advice](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice): Editorial hub for buying guides, how-tos, checklists, and design inspiration.
- [Buying Guides](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/guides): Product selection guides across furniture, decor, and home improvement.
- [How-To Guides](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/how-to): Practical articles for setup, maintenance, decorating, and home projects.
- [Checklist Guides](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/checklists): Planning checklists for moving, furnishing, entertaining, and seasonal tasks.
- [Design Inspiration](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/inspiration): Curated style ideas, room looks, and decorating inspiration.
- [Trends](https://www.wayfair.com/sca/ideas-and-advice/trends): Trend-focused content covering current home styles and seasonal looks.

## Customer Help
- [Help Center](https://www.wayfair.com/help): Central support hub for orders, returns, shipping, and account help.
- [Track My Order](https://www.wayfair.com/help/article/track_my_order): Instructions for checking order status and shipment progress.
- [Returns & Refunds](https://www.wayfair.com/help/article/returns_and_refunds): Policies and guidance for returns, replacements, and refund processing.
- [Shipping Information](https://www.wayfair.com/help/article/shipping_information): Details about delivery methods, timing, and shipping expectations.
- [Damaged or Missing Items](https://www.wayfair.com/help/article/damaged_or_missing_items): Support information for reporting damaged, defective, or missing products.
- [Manage My Account](https://www.wayfair.com/help/article/manage_my_account): Help for account settings, addresses, payment methods, and sign-in.
- [Wayfair Credit Card](https://www.wayfair.com/help/article/wayfair_credit_card): Support information for Wayfair credit card holders and applicants.

## Programs & Services
- [Wayfair Professional](https://www.wayfair.com/professional/): Business purchasing program for trade professionals and commercial buyers.
- [Wayfair Registry](https://www.wayfair.com/registry/): Create and manage wedding, baby, and housewarming gift registries.
- [Open Box](https://www.wayfair.com/open-box/cat/open-box-c1861104.html): Shop discounted returned and overstock items across home categories.
- [Sale](https://www.wayfair.com/sale/b/sale-c1860465.html): Browse promotional pricing across furniture, decor, and home essentials.
- [Financing](https://www.wayfair.com/financing): Learn about financing options and payment programs for purchases.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.wayfair.com/giftcards): Purchase and redeem Wayfair gift cards for home shopping.

## Supplier & Partner Resources
- [Sell with Wayfair](https://sell.wayfair.com/): Supplier portal for brands and vendors interested in selling on Wayfair.
- [Supplier Homepage](https://sell.wayfair.com/get-started): Overview of onboarding and getting started as a Wayfair supplier.
- [CastleGate Forwarding](https://sell.wayfair.com/castlegate-forwarding): Logistics and fulfillment program information for supplier inventory.
- [Advertising with Wayfair](https://sell.wayfair.com/advertising): Retail media and advertising options for suppliers and brand partners.
- [Supplier Education](https://sell.wayfair.com/education): Training resources and operational guidance for Wayfair suppliers.
- [Optimize Your Products](https://sell.wayfair.com/start-optimize-products): Guidance for improving product content and merchandising performance.

## Policies & Legal
- [Terms of Use](https://www.wayfair.com/terms_of_use): Legal terms governing use of Wayfair websites and services.
